thread:
Priya: Quick planning thread for deterministic slice + shadow cutover for EU model-v2. Goal: catch per-tenant regressions early. Proposal: header-driven slice assignment + 6-hr shadow window at 8% traffic, then 20% tenant cohort canary.
Anil: Strong +1 for header-driven. Use X-RW-Slice: slice-NNN so QA can replay exact traffic. Avoid random pct for first two phases.
Zoe: Rollback gates: automated rollback if error_rate > 0.7% sustained 3m OR token_cost increases >30% for 15m. Also require manual sign-off to expand beyond tenant cohort to all traffic.
Max: Ops asks: add an instance-level probe /health?variant=v2 that returns version + kv_hit_rate + recent_p95. k8s readiness should check variant health to avoid sending traffic during warmup.
Priya: Shadowing detail: async mirror (no response path) with X-RW-Shadow: true. Compute embedding drift and rerank top-k delta; raise a regression alert if mean rerank delta > 0.12 on sample set.
Anil: Flag schema: eu_model_v2 -> {rollout_mode: "header|pct|tenant", slice_map: <list>, shadow_pct, exempt_tenants}. Console should display per-tenant variant.
Zoe: Circuit-breaker: after automated rollback, open circuit for 30m and send alert to #incidents + rollout-audit. Block auto-promote for 2h.
Max: Note on resource cost: shadow 8% ~ +9% GPU hours (24h). If we keep shadow 6h it's roughly +2.2% GPU. I'll add a small table to RFC.
OpsBot: rollout-job-99211 started: creating header routing rule and setting eu_model_v2 mode=header with slice-NNN mapped to v2. apply-step-1 OK.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to draft RFC with exact slice IDs and tenant cohort (due tomorrow). 2) Anil to implement header routing + flag UI. 3) Max to add variant health probe and cost estimate. 4) Zoe to wire rollback automation + alerts.
Anil: I'll also add a debug header X-RW-Debug: show-variant for support to verify routing.
Priya: scheduling a 20m sync with SRE after RFC posted. If no objections by EOD, I'll post. :thumbsup:
Zoe: ACK
Max: ACK
